title: An agent from the template answering its own goldens (SPEC/06 section 1, item 4; R7)
description: Written by verdict.build answer only, in agentkeel's deploy.yml on main, after the platform deployed an agent repository's commit. Keyed to that commit. Put once under envelopes/agents/<name>/<commit>.json in the security account's bucket; scripts/observe_template.py reads it for F6.3's answer record, and from M09 PR 2 scripts/observe_rules.py reads its observations and its guardrail for the plant run (SPEC/09 §4; R7: the blocked observation's shape is the one build writes for refagent's plants). Not gated.

guardrail.description: From M09 PR 2 (SPEC/09 §2, 'The placeholder pin'): the guardrail the stack built and the call carried, as deploy.yml read it from the stack's outputs, never the manifest's pin. F9.1 reads it. Absent on a record of an agent without rules/, and on every record before M09 PR 2.

observations.description: From M09 PR 2 (R7): each golden's observation as the runner recorded it, the shape build scores refagent's plants from: stop_reason (guardrail_intervened is the only block), guardrail_topics (the rule names the converse trace recorded; a plant fired only when its named rule is among them) and the parsed answer. Optional, so every record before it validates.
